1. (Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, __wherein the housing includes a removable front cover that provides access to internal components of the cooling system__.

2. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __approximately__ sixteen inches on center.

3. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced about twenty-four inches on center.

4. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, __and wherein the water distributor includes a plurality of distribution tubes positioned above the pad__.

5. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation, __and wherein the fan is positioned to draw air through the pad from an exterior side of the structure wall__.

6. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening __into an interior space of the structure__.

7. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation __through a collection tray positioned below the pad__.

8. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover __that is removable to provide access to the water reservoir, pump, and pad for maintenance__.

12. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall __of a residential or commercial building__.

14. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Currently Amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; mounting elements __including brackets configured to attach the housing to the studs__; and a ventilation grill.

16. (Previously presented) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

17. (Currently Amended) A cooling system, comprising: __a housing configured for mounting__ within a structure wall, __an evaporative cooling assembly disposed within the housing and configured to evaporatively cool__ an indoor area.

18. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein __the housing is configured for mounting by placing the evaporative cooling assembly__ between wall studs spaced __approximately__ sixteen inches on center.

19. (Previously presented) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the means for mounting includes placing the means for evaporatively cooling within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF).

20. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the __housing__ protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
